title: Going back to the phone's record clears the cloud erase before its await and never clears the cloud session, so the screen can mix the two
evidence: Source union (US-25 AC11o): RecordStore.source is phone, leaving or cloud, changed only by the pure RecordStore.Source.transition (RecordStore+Source.swift, 21 cells, no default arm, RecordSourceTests). showPhone moves cloud to leaving, where the screen and the mark still report the cloud, then lands the phone's record, drawing and source in one step; the phone case has no session field. An edit asked during the read is refused in its turn with the existing words and never reaches the phone's file (RecordSourcePinsTests testShowPhoneReportsTheCloudUntilThePhoneRecordLands, testShowPhoneDropsTheCloudSession, testADisconnectDropsTheCloudSession; failed first). Was: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift:25-50,87-88,238-248 (showPhone). iPhone survey 2026-11-11 (main fcc4ed9b) S10
